messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stop taking and call doctor right away"
set: ["stop taking and call doctor right away", "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior", "call doctor right away if become pregnant while taking", "call doctor right away if you have weakness", "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur", "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur", "call your doctor right away if you experience agitation", "call your doctor right away if you have tenderness", "call doctor right away if you have dark urine", "stop using and call doctor at once", "stop taking", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away", "call your doctor right away if you experience extreme worry", "call your doctor right away if you experience panic attacks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant",
    "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior",
    "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur",
    "stop using and call doctor at once",
    "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately",
    "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away"
  ],
  "alias": "stop taking and call doctor right away"
}
